## Week 1 · 1-D Dynamic Programming (days 121–127)

### Day 121 — DP foundations

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** Go from recursion to memoisation to tabulation to O(1) space.

**Learn / do:**

- Define the state in one sentence before writing code
- Top-down with a cache, then bottom-up
- Rolling variables when only the last few states matter

| Problem | Difficulty |
|---|---|
| [70. Climbing Stairs](https://leetcode.com/problems/climbing-stairs/) ⭐ | 🟢 Easy |
| [746. Min Cost Climbing Stairs](https://leetcode.com/problems/min-cost-climbing-stairs/) | 🟢 Easy |
| [1137. N-th Tribonacci Number](https://leetcode.com/problems/n-th-tribonacci-number/) | 🟢 Easy |

### Day 122 — House robber family

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** Choose/skip transitions with adjacency constraints.

**Learn / do:**

- dp[i] = max(dp[i−1], dp[i−2] + a[i])
- Circular: run twice excluding either end
- Delete-and-earn reduces to robber over values

| Problem | Difficulty |
|---|---|
| [198. House Robber](https://leetcode.com/problems/house-robber/) ⭐ | 🟡 Medium |
| [213. House Robber II](https://leetcode.com/problems/house-robber-ii/) ⭐ | 🟡 Medium |
| [740. Delete and Earn](https://leetcode.com/problems/delete-and-earn/) | 🟡 Medium |

### Day 123 — Linear DP with choices

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** Count decodings, segment strings and sum squares.

**Learn / do:**

- Look back 1 and 2 characters with validity checks
- dp[i] = any(dp[j] and s[j:i] in dict)
- Unbounded minimum over perfect squares

| Problem | Difficulty |
|---|---|
| [91. Decode Ways](https://leetcode.com/problems/decode-ways/) ⭐ | 🟡 Medium |
| [139. Word Break](https://leetcode.com/problems/word-break/) ⭐ | 🟡 Medium |
| [279. Perfect Squares](https://leetcode.com/problems/perfect-squares/) | 🟡 Medium |

### Day 124 — Longest increasing subsequence

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** O(n²) DP, then the O(n log n) patience-sorting trick.

**Learn / do:**

- dp[i] = 1 + max(dp[j]) for j < i with a[j] < a[i]
- Patience sorting with bisect for length
- Sort by width asc, height desc, then LIS on heights

| Problem | Difficulty |
|---|---|
| [300. Longest Increasing Subsequence](https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-increasing-subsequence/) ⭐ | 🟡 Medium |
| [673. Number of Longest Increasing Subsequence](https://leetcode.com/problems/number-of-longest-increasing-subsequence/) | 🟡 Medium |
| [354. Russian Doll Envelopes](https://leetcode.com/problems/russian-doll-envelopes/) | 🔴 Hard |

### Day 125 — Kadane variants

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** Track more than one running value per position.

**Learn / do:**

- Keep running max and min for products
- Best pair = max(a[i]+i) seen so far + a[j]−j
- Alternate up/down run lengths

### Day 127 — Subset-sum DP

`Learn` · Pattern: [1-D Dynamic Programming](../patterns/dp-1d.md)

**Goal:** Feasibility and counting over reachable sums.

**Learn / do:**

- Bitset/boolean array of reachable sums, iterate items, sums descending
- Target sum = count subsets with (total + target)/2
- Minimise difference between two groups

## Week 2 · 2-D & Knapsack DP · String DP (days 128–134)

### Day 128 — Grid DP

`Learn` · Pattern: [2-D & Knapsack DP](../patterns/dp-2d.md)

**Goal:** Paths and minimum sums over grids with obstacles.

### Day 132 — LCS family

`Learn` · Pattern: [String DP](../patterns/dp-strings.md)

**Goal:** Two-string DP with match/skip transitions.

**Learn / do:**

- dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i−1][j−1] if match else max of skips
- Edit distance adds replace; three transitions
- Deletions = m + n − 2·LCS

`Learn` · Pattern: [String DP](../patterns/dp-strings.md)

### Day 134 — Regex & palindromic subsequences

`Learn` · Pattern: [String DP](../patterns/dp-strings.md)

**Goal:** Handle '*' lookbehind and reversed-string tricks.

**Learn / do:**

- Regex: '*' means zero or more of the previous char — two sub-cases
- LPS = LCS(s, reverse(s)) or interval DP
- Insertions to palindrome = n − LPS

### Day 135 — Interval DP

`Learn` · Pattern: [Interval, Tree, Bitmask & Digit DP](../patterns/dp-advanced.md)

**Goal:** Choose the last operation inside a range and split on it.

- Leaf values: merge the smallest leaf with its smaller neighbour (or interval DP)

### Day 136 — Game theory & partitions

`Learn` · Pattern: [Interval, Tree, Bitmask & Digit DP](../patterns/dp-advanced.md)

**Goal:** Minimax over intervals and palindromic cuts.

**Learn / do:**

- Score difference DP: dp[l][r] = max(a[l] − dp[l+1][r], a[r] − dp[l][r−1])
- Predict the winner is the same recurrence
- Palindrome partitioning II: precompute is-palindrome table
